mapper.sql: id, category_id, title, summary, content, cover_url, artist_id, author, view_count, status, published_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (category_id, title, summary, content, cover_url, artist_id, author, view_count, status, published_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverUrl}, #{artistId}, #{author}, #{viewCount}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, artist_id = #{artistId}, author = #{author}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
